_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROCUREMENT STRATEGY' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.09.02.

f01_Project_Delivery_Method.label: Project Delivery Method
f01_Project_Delivery_Method.guidance: The selected delivery structure (e.g., Design-Build, Turnkey EPC, Professional Services, Agile Staff Augmentation).

f02_Contract_Payment_Types_and_Rationale.label: Contract Payment Types and Rationale
f02_Contract_Payment_Types_and_Rationale.guidance: Selected contract payment mechanism (Firm Fixed Price, Cost Reimbursable, Target Price) and justification.

f03_Incentive_Fees_and_Bonus_Provisions.label: Incentive Fees and Bonus Provisions
f03_Incentive_Fees_and_Bonus_Provisions.guidance: Performance-based financial incentives, early completion bonuses, or quality metrics.

f04_Penalty_and_Liquidated_Damages_Claus.label: Penalty and Liquidated Damages Clauses
f04_Penalty_and_Liquidated_Damages_Claus.guidance: Contractual liquidated damages and penalty provisions for unexcused schedule delays.

f05_Procurement_Sourcing_Stages.section: Procurement Phases and Sourcing Life Cycle
f05_Procurement_Sourcing_Stages.label: Procurement Sourcing Stages
f05_Procurement_Sourcing_Stages.guidance: Sequence of procurement stages: market analysis, pre-qualification, RFP issuance, evaluation, negotiation, award.

f06_Market_Engagement_and_Competitive_So.section: Procurement Phases and Sourcing Life Cycle
f06_Market_Engagement_and_Competitive_So.label: Market Engagement and Competitive Sourcing Approach
f06_Market_Engagement_and_Competitive_So.guidance: Method of market engagement (Sole Source, Open Competitive Tender, Limited Request for Quotation).
